basics.tagline: Staff Software Engineer working on large web products shared by many teams.

work.name: Personio
highlights: Removed a recurring source of architectural drift in my domain by moving its data access onto the company GraphQL layer, retiring 20+ legacy REST endpoints across 5+ entities without pausing feature delivery.
Gave 4+ product domains one shared way to integrate company-wide group management by defining and owning its frontend integration model.
Led the components my domain provides on top of the design system, giving teams a consistent UX and stable, battle-tested access to our data.
Cut p75 LCP by 21% on high-traffic surfaces, measured in real-user monitoring, by removing unused JavaScript and redrawing bundle boundaries.

work.name: Personio
highlights: Unblocked feature development for 5+ frontend applications by leading their migration off a legacy monolith, where changes had become slow, risky and in some cases impractical.
Delivered the company-wide UI rebrand for my domain with full parity at launch, coordinating 12+ stakeholders and running a parallel-UI release.
Let multiple product teams ship location-based features without each integrating third-party services, by designing shared geolocation and mapping infrastructure.
Established a recurring frontend architecture forum that teams use to align on shared decisions.

work.name: DAZN
highlights: Gave multiple teams consistent validation and version control for content models by designing and building governance tooling for the headless CMS.
Decoupled landing-page layout from frontend release cycles by leading the move to Server-Driven UI on Next.js.
Improved brand consistency and accessibility and reduced UI build time across 3+ frontend teams by driving design-system adoption through guidance and code review.
Made CI feedback more reliable for a large monorepo, and cut manual publishing errors and version drift by standardizing automated release workflows for cross-team libraries.

work.name: DAZN
highlights: Established the atomic component patterns adopted across DAZN's web applications by leading core design-system components and design tokens, including token naming standards.
Gave product surfaces one consistent way to format dates, times and currencies by building shared internationalization utilities.
Presented architecture proposals to the frontend guild and technical council.

Technically led a product team through development cycles and mentored engineers inside and outside the company.
Performance guild member, contributing to the organisation's frontend strategy.

work.name: Travix

Aligned logging standards company-wide by creating the shared server- and client-side logging library.

work.name: Travix
